Class AlloyBackend

java.lang.Object
org.clafer.alloy.solve.AlloyBackend
All Implemented Interfaces:
Backend
public final class AlloyBackend extends Object implements Backend
The Alloy backend of the solution loop, for a temporal model: claferIG's ClaferIG.hs, and its commands of CommandLine.hs, on an AlloySession in this JVM. The model is translated by the frontend's port of the compiler's AlloyLtl generator, with -k, as claferIG has the compiler translate it; the code is given to Alloy in memory.
